description: The two-body radial collision (dd_validation_orbits § 2): two equal masses 1/3 from rest at (±1/2, 0), the third at rest far away at (0, 20), the pair falling head-on through collision near t = 1.36, run to t = 2 on Δ_sync = 1/8, under the default occupant, Heggie × RK4 under Eq. 22 (R-560, R-161), registered once at t = 0 (integrator_contract Part 2b). It passes through d_min < 1e-10 with the regularised energy's drift below 1e-12 (R-257, R-566), the value read bitwise the occupant's own, the Cartesian read-out after the passage printed beside it and different, and that read-out not falling with η over the ladder.
